thread:
samira_cs: Quick sync — Skyforge dedicated bring-up today at 16:00 PT. Quota assigned: 320k tokens/min, burst 480k for 5m. Need confirmations on autoscale policy, priming plan, and smoke load test window. Who can own run & results?

josh_ops: I can run the smoke and the 30m soak. Plan to run from 16:05-16:35 PT. Will use the 'tiered' autoscale policy (min=2, target=6, max=12).

ravi_eng: FYI the model they pinned is rdx-7b-quant. We saw KV cache warmup taking ~60s on long convo sequences in staging. Recommend a prefix prime of 350 tokens before starting real traffic.

ben_platform: @josh_ops I'll attach the autoscale config we'll use to mirror production: 
```
policy: workload_aware
min_replicas: 2
target_rps_per_replica: 50
scale_up_cooldown: 30s
scale_down_cooldown: 120s
max_replicas: 12
fallback_model: rdx-3b-cost
```

ana_qa: typo — I'm ana_qa (small nit). I'll validate correctness and run the smoke tests in parallel. I'll check response p95 latency < 450ms during soak.

josh_ops: Load command I'll run: 
```
loadgen --customer Skyforge --target-rps 250 --dur 30m --concurrency 60 --headers "x-customer:skyforge" --seed-prompts loadset/skyforge-priming.json
```

samira_cs: Great. Exporting list of critical checkpoints: 1) Quota and billing flag verified with finance; 2) KMS key rotated and accessible for logs; 3) Canary route pointing to dedicated pool; 4) Autoscale & fallback observed under soak; 5) Post-soak quality check on 50 promo prompts.

ben_platform: Finance checked — quota allowance is live. KMS thumbprint matches. Canary route configured: skyforge-canary -> dedicated-pool-a.

ana_qa: During a quick dry run in staging I saw occasional 503s at ~7 replicas under burst; logs show a transient CUDA OOM on one node, then pod restarted. Captured logs snippet: 
```
W tensorflow: Allocator (GPU_0_bfc) ran out of memory trying to allocate 1.1GiB
E inference: kv-cache-restore failed for session XYZ
```

ravi_eng: Thanks — that aligns with our kernel selection fallback triggering. For production run: set node-level GPU margin to 0.9 (reduce per-replica batch) and enable pod anti-affinity to spread replicas. I'll push a tuned runtime flag now.

josh_ops: Running the soak now. First 10m: ramp to 250rps over 3m, hold 20m, ramp down 7m. I'll post the smoke metrics link when done. :eyes:

samira_cs: I'll be on the call. If we see >1% error rate or p95 > 600ms we abort and switch to fallback model. Also capture 50 example traces for quality check.

deploy-bot: deploy status: autoscale-config update applied to dedicated-pool-a by ben_platform at 2024-10-12T15:50:12Z :white_check_mark:

ana_qa: 10m update — error rate holding at 0.4%, p95=410ms, one pod restart at 00:07 due to OOM (same as staging). Captured traces and uploaded to /artifacts/skyforge/soak-1718205000.

ravi_eng: I've bumped GPU margin to 0.85 and adjusted kernel policy; requesting Josh to continue but keep watch. Also enabling automatic fallback to rdx-3b-cost at 2% error or sustained p95>700ms.

josh_ops: Continuing. Current pool replicas: 3 -> scaled to 5 during ramp. Observed token throughput stable at ~310k/min. No sustained latency spikes.

samira_cs: Awesome. Post-soak items: QA to run semantic quality check on saved traces, CS to confirm customer enablement doc updated with warmup guidance, and renewals lead to be notified of any SLA anomalies. I'll file a short runbook note in the Skyforge account. :thumbsup:

ben_platform: Runbook note posted and Slack channel #skyforge-ready created. Will follow up with a short retrospective tomorrow.

samira_cs: Thanks everyone — close the loop after the QA pass and we'll schedule the handoff call with Skyforge PMs for Monday morning.

josh_ops: Ending soak run. Final: error rate 0.55%, p95 395ms, peak replicas 7, peak tokens/min 472k (short burst). Uploading final metrics now.

ana_qa: QA pass complete: 48/50 prompts within acceptable quality delta. Two regressions logged, investigating.

samira_cs: Filing renewal risk note: regressions noted but contained; not blocking. Will include remediation timeline in the account health doc. Thanks all.
